William Henry Jackson photographs of Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, New Mexico, Utah, and Mexico WA Photos Folio 215 Conditions Governing Use The William Henry Jackson Photographs of Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, New Mexico, Utah, and Mexico is the physical property of the Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library, Yale University. Literary rights, including copyright, belong to the authors or their legal heirs and assigns. For further information, consult the appropriate curator. Preferred Citation William Henry Jackson, Photographs of Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, New Mexico, Utah, and Mexico. Yale Collection of Western Americana, Beinecke Rare Book and Manuscript Library. Processing Information Collections are processed to a variety of levels, depending on the work necessary to make them usable, their perceived research value, the availability of sta, competing priorities, and whether or not further accruals are expected. The library attempts to provide a basic level of preservation and access for all collections, and does more extensive processing of higher priority collections as time and resources permit. These materials have been arranged and described according to national and local standards. For more information, please refer to the Beinecke Manuscript Unit Processing Manual. Collection list derived from captions in the negative. Scope and Contents Photographs taken by William Henry Jackson and published by W.H. Jackson & Co. of Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, New Mexico, Utah, and Mexico, circa 1880s. Bibliography William Henry Jackson (1843-1943), American photographer, opened a studio in Denver, Colorado, in 1879. He incorporated himself as W.H. Jackson Photograph and Publishing Company, Inc. in 1883. Arrangement Arranged by number assigned in the negative. Page 4 of 9
